videoSummary:
Screen recording of about 9 min 40 s (145 frames, one every 4 s). It shows Odoo Accounting on Odoo Online: rya-cafe.odoo.com, database rya-cafe, company 'Rya Cafe', user 'Rayya cafe'. The interface is Arabic, right to left, with developer mode on (?debug=1). It was recorded on 14 Sep 2026 between about 9:56 and 10:05 PM (Monday). The presenter only looks around: nothing is posted, saved or changed.
00:00-00:28 Home screen with 19 installed apps, including Accounting, Point of Sale, Kitchen Display, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Barcode, Documents and Employees. Hovering the Accounting tile shows the link /odoo/accounting.
00:32-00:48 Accounting dashboard with 9 journal cards, filtered by Favorites:
- Sales: due-date bar chart and a New button.
- Purchases: email alias purchases@rya-cafe.odoo.com, Upload, New, kebab menu and a due-date chart.
- Al Rajhi Bank: Balance 408,568.91 SR, Misc operations -344,531.19 SR, Bank setup and Transactions buttons.
- Miscellaneous Operations: Tax Returns button.
- Cash (النقديه): Balance 71,906.90 SR, Misc operations -66,774.55 SR, Transactions button.
- Point of Sale, Tax Adjustments, IFRS 16 Right of Use Asset and Zakat: a New button each.
00:52-01:04 Configuration > Chart of Accounts (/odoo/action-273). 213 accounts, 80 per page. Columns: Code, Account Name, Type, Allow Reconciliation toggle. A side panel filters by code prefix (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9). A debug tooltip on the Account Name header shows field 'name', model account.account, char, required.
01:08-01:16 Search dropdown. Filters: Receivable, Payable, Equity, Assets, Liability, Income, Expenses, Accounts with entries, Inactive accounts, custom filter. Group By: Account type or a custom field. Favorites: Save current search.
01:20-02:20 Grouped by account type: 16 types whose counts add up to 213. The Bank and Cash group is expanded (111101 النقدية, 111201 بنك الراجحي), then collapsed.
02:24-02:44 Accounting menu opened, in three sections:
- Transactions: Journal Entries.
- Assets & Liabilities: Assets, Loans.
- Closing: Reconcile, Tax Returns, Lock Dates..., Secure Entries.
02:48 Journal Entries list (/odoo/entries): 808 posted entries under the default Posted filter. Each POS session creates three entries: a session entry (POSS/2026/09/xxxx), a combined card-payment entry in Al Rajhi Bank (PBNK1/2026/xxxxx) and a cash entry (CSH2/2026/xxxxx). There are also manual MISC entries for payouts, a profit distribution and expenses.
02:52-03:52 New manual journal entry (/odoo/entries/new):
- Fields: Reference, Accounting Date (defaults to today, 14 Sep), Journal (defaults to Miscellaneous Operations).
- Tabs: Journal Items and Other Info.
- A line is added (debit and credit 0.00 SR, totals row) and the account autocomplete shows code, name and description.
- The Post button is hovered but never clicked, and the draft is abandoned.
03:56-04:56 Back to the list, the presenter opens MISC/2026/09/0006 'ديكور اليوم الوطني' (/odoo/entries/1007):
- Posted entry: debit 400034 اعلانات 360.00, credit 111201 بنك الراجحي 360.00.
- Header: Reverse Entry and Reset to Draft buttons, and a 'لا توجد مراجعة' (not reviewed) badge.
- The attached Al Rajhi transfer receipt PDF is previewed beside the form.
- Chatter tracking: created on 12 Sep, date changed from 2026/09/12 to 2026/09/10, then number assigned and state set to Posted.
05:00-05:44 Reporting menu, then Profit and Loss for 2026 (/odoo/profit-and-loss), shown with a banner warning about unposted entries:

|---|---|

05:48-06:12 Date filter: Month, Quarter and Fiscal year presets with previous/next arrows, plus custom dates with day and month pickers. The range is changed to Jul-Dec 2026, then to Jul-Aug 2026 (Revenue 220,171.18, Operating Income 68,021.50).
06:16-06:52 Balance Sheet as of 14/09/2026 (/odoo/balance-sheet):

- Bank and Cash unfolded to 111101 (5,132.35) and 111201 (64,037.72), then folded back.
06:56-07:00 Reporting menu reopened, then the full Configuration menu. Settings; Accounting section: Chart of Accounts, Taxes, Journals, Currencies, Fiscal Positions, Multi-Ledger, Tax Groups, Tax Units, Account Tags, Accounting Reports, Horizontal Groups, Checks, Financial categories, Depreciation Models, Return Types, Financial Budgets, Online Synchronization. Invoicing section: Payment Terms, Incoterms. The list continues below the visible area.

09:04-09:36 Reporting > Trial Balance for September 2026 (/odoo/trial-balance). Columns: Opening balance | Debit | Credit | End balance. 22 account rows are visible and the grand totals are below the fold. The presenter hovers the Dashboard menu at 09:32, and the recording ends on the Trial Balance.

features.name: Reporting menu dropdown
features.details:
Five groups:
- تقارير كشف الحساب (Statement Reports): الميزانية العمومية Balance Sheet (/odoo/balance-sheet), الربح والخسارة Profit and Loss (/odoo/profit-and-loss), كشف التدفقات النقدية Cash Flow Statement.
- دفاتر الأستاذ (Ledgers): ميزان المراجعة Trial Balance (/odoo/trial-balance), دفتر الأستاذ العام General Ledger.
- تقارير الشركاء (Partner Reports): دفتر الأستاذ العام للشركاء Partner Ledger, المتأخر المدين Aged Receivable, حسابات دائنة مستحقة متأخرة Aged Payable.
- الضرائب والشؤون المالية (Taxes & Financial): التقرير الضريبي Tax Report, التقرير المالي Financial Report.
- الإدارة (Management): تحليل الفاتورة Invoice Analysis, تقرير تحليلي Analytic Report, الملخص التنفيذي Executive Summary.

A scrollable dropdown, cut off at the bottom:

- المحاسبة (Accounting): شجرة الحسابات Chart of Accounts (/odoo/action-273), الضرائب Taxes, دفاتر اليومية Journals, العملات Currencies, الأوضاع المالية Fiscal Positions, دفتر الأستاذ المتعدد Multi-Ledger, مجموعات الضرائب Tax Groups, الوحدات الضريبية Tax Units, علامات تصنيف الحساب Account Tags, التقارير المحاسبية Accounting Reports, المجموعات الأفقية Horizontal Groups, الفحوصات Checks, الفئات المالية Financial categories, Depreciation Models (untranslated), أنواع الإقرارات Return Types, الميزانيات المالية Financial Budgets, المزامنة عبر الإنترنت Online Synchronization.

features.name: Standard list/search/form interaction patterns
features.details:
Features that recur across screens:
- Removable search facets with icons (funnel for a filter, layers for a group-by, star for favorites).
- A search dropdown with three columns: Filters, Group By, Favorites.
- Pager 'first-last / total' with previous/next arrows.
- View switcher icons.
- Optional-columns toggler at the end of the header.
- Select-all and per-row checkboxes for bulk actions.
- Breadcrumbs back to the list, and a record pager inside a form (e.g. 16 / 80).
- Gear actions menu next to the title.
- Manual save (cloud icon) and discard (x) on forms.
- A 'جاري التحميل...' loading toast at bottom-left.
- Hovered rows highlight.

features.name: Arabic RTL localization, number/date formatting and translation quirks
features.nameAr: الواجهة العربية وتنسيق الأرقام والتواريخ وملاحظات الترجمة
features.details:
Layout is fully right to left.
- Amounts: 2 decimals, comma thousands separators, 'SR' suffix (e.g. 36,147.00 SR). Report negatives are red with a trailing minus (3,210.34-); negatives on the dashboard use a leading minus (-344,531.19).
- Dates: lists and forms show Arabic-Indic day and month without the year for the current year (١٣ سبتمبر). The chatter shows full dates (١٢ سبتمبر ٢٠٢٦) and time ٩:٥٨ م. Report date labels use Latin digits (14/09/2026). Custom date inputs use Arabic-Indic digits (٠١/٠٧/٢٠٢٦).
- Literal or wrong translations: عدد (Number), بطاقة عنوان (Label), منشور (for the Post button), الطرد (Package), خصائص خصم الدفع المبكر (for the early payment discount loss account), 'عند تصديق فاتورة المورّد' (used for deferred revenue too).
- Untranslated English strings: Automatic Invoice Reminders, Withholding / Withholding Tax Base, By Months, Depreciation Models, Previous Years Earnings, Inventory Accounting, Periodic (at closing), Periodic Valuation, Inventory Cost Method, Valuation Account, 'There are ... prior or included in this period', 'end of year balances', 'for full history'.

features.name: Journal kanban dashboard
features.details:
Landing page 'لوحة البيانات' at /odoo/accounting. It shows one card per journal in a 3-column grid, pager '1-9 / 9', and a gear actions icon beside the title. The search bar has a default removable 'المفضلات' (Favorites) facet, so only journals marked to show on the dashboard appear. Placeholder 'بحث...'; the filter dropdown was not opened.

Card order, right to left by row:
- المبيعات, المشتريات, بنك الراجحي
- عمليات متنوعة, النقديه, Point of Sale
- Tax Adjustments, IFRS 16 Right of Use Asset, Zakat

Card content depends on journal type:
- sale/purchase: due-date bar chart plus action buttons
- bank/cash: Balance and Misc operations figures, a balance trend line chart and Transactions
- general: a New button

Only the Sales and Purchases cards have a coloured (purple) side border, which suggests a per-journal colour field. Charts load asynchronously behind a 'جاري التحميل...' toast and then re-render. Journals seen in settings but not on the dashboard: ضرائب بأساس نقدي, تقييم المخزون.

features.name: Sales journal card with receivables due-date buckets
features.nameAr: بطاقة دفتر المبيعات مع تقادم المستحقات
features.details: Card titled 'المبيعات' with a 'جديد' (New) button that creates a customer invoice in this journal. The bar chart has 6 buckets, left to right: 'مستحق' (overdue), '7 - 13 سبتمبر', 'هذا الأسبوع' (this week, 14-20 Sep; today is Monday 14 Sep 2026, so buckets are Monday-based weeks), '21 - 27 سبتمبر', '28 سبتمبر - 4 أكتوبر', 'غير مستحق' (not due, later). There are no axis values. Bars are light grey and changed height after loading, which matches Odoo sample-data placeholders; the Balance Sheet shows Receivables 0.00, so there are no open invoices.

features.name: Purchases journal card
features.details: Card titled 'المشتريات' with a purple border. It shows the email alias purchases@rya-cafe.odoo.com, a primary 'رفع' (Upload bill document) button, a secondary 'جديد' (New bill) button, and a kebab '⋮' menu whose contents were not shown. Its due-date chart uses the same 6 buckets as Sales (مستحق, 7-13 سبتمبر, هذا الأسبوع, 21-27 سبتمبر, 28 سبتمبر-4 أكتوبر, غير مستحق). Bars are grey sample-style and changed after loading; Payables are 0.00 on the Balance Sheet.

features.name: Bank journal card (Al Rajhi Bank)
features.details: Card titled 'بنك الراجحي' with buttons 'إعداد البنك' (Bank setup / connect bank) and 'المعاملات' (Transactions). It shows two figures: 'الرصيد' (Balance) 408,568.91 SR and 'العمليات المنوعة/المتنوعة' (Misc. operations) -344,531.19 SR. Below them is a faint grey balance line chart with no axes, wave-shaped after loading and possibly sample styling. Derived check: 408,568.91 + (-344,531.19) = 64,037.72, exactly the GL balance of 111201 on the Balance Sheet and Trial Balance. So 'Balance' is the bank-transactions (statement lines) balance and 'Misc. operations' is the amount posted directly to the account outside statement lines.

features.name: Cash journal card
features.details: Card titled 'النقديه' with a 'المعاملات' (Transactions) button and no bank-setup button. Figures: 'الرصيد' 71,906.90 SR and 'العمليات المنوعة' -66,774.55 SR. A purple area/line chart with about 28 points trends steadily upward (real data). Derived check: 71,906.90 - 66,774.55 = 5,132.35, the GL balance of 111101 النقدية.

features.name: Miscellaneous Operations card with Tax Returns shortcut
features.nameAr: بطاقة العمليات المتنوعة مع اختصار الإقرارات الضريبية
features.details: Card titled 'عمليات متنوعة' with a single button 'الإقرارات الضريبية' (Tax Returns) and no chart or figures. This journal is also the default for manual entries, tax return closing and deferral entries (see Settings). The Tax Returns screen was not opened.

features.name: Point of Sale, Tax Adjustments, IFRS 16 and Zakat journal cards
features.nameAr: بطاقات نقطة البيع وتسويات الضريبة وIFRS 16 والزكاة
features.details: Four cards with English names, each with only a 'جديد' (New entry) button and no figures or charts: 'Point of Sale', 'Tax Adjustments', 'IFRS 16 Right of Use Asset', 'Zakat'.

features.name: Chart of Accounts list view
features.details:
Configuration > شجرة الحسابات at /odoo/action-273 (model account.account).
- Control panel: primary 'جديد' (New account), 'استيراد' (Import), title with a gear actions menu, search 'بحث...' with a dropdown toggle.
- Views: list (active) and kanban.
- Pager '1-80 / 213': 80 per page, 213 accounts.
- Columns: select-all checkbox, 'رمز' Code, 'اسم الحساب' Account Name (char, required), 'النوع' Type, 'تسوية المدفوعات' Allow Reconciliation (switch), optional-columns toggler.
- Rows are sorted by code; the first page starts at 100001.

features.name: Inline Allow Reconciliation toggle per account
features.details:
The 'تسوية المدفوعات' column is a switch in each list row.
- ON: 100001 الأموال قيد التحويل, 100103 ضريبة القيمة المضافة المدينة, 101003 الإيصالات المستحقة, 101004 المدفوعات المستحقة.
- OFF: fixed-asset accounts (1001xx), 101005 الخزنة الرئيسية, 101006 الخزنة الرئيسية - العملات الأجنبية.
- Hidden (blank cell): Bank and Cash accounts 111101 and 111201, so the toggle is hidden for liquidity-type accounts.

- أصول ثابتة (Fixed Assets): 13

- الدخل (Income): 12

features.name: Group by account type with collapsible groups and counts
features.nameAr: التجميع حسب نوع الحساب مع مجموعات قابلة للطي وعدّاد
features.details: Applying Group By 'نوع الحساب' adds a removable facet with a layers icon. The pager then counts groups ('1-16 / 16') and a 'التعداد' (Count) column appears. Each group header has a caret that expands it to account rows or collapses it. The video expands Bank and Cash (111101 النقدية, 111201 بنك الراجحي, both typed البنك والنقد), then collapses it. Group rows highlight on hover.

features.name: Account code hierarchy side panel
features.details: A collapsible search panel lists 'الكل' (All, selected) and the top-level code roots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, each with a caret to drill into deeper prefixes. Selecting a node filters the accounts by code prefix. Only the top level was shown.

features.name: Search filters, group-by options and saved favorites
features.details:
Search dropdown with three columns:
- 'عوامل التصفية' (Filters, funnel icon): المدين Receivable, الدائن Payable, رأس المال Equity, أصول Assets, التزام Liability, الدخل Income, النفقات Expenses. After a separator: 'حساب مع قيود' (Accounts with entries) and 'الحسابات غير النشطة' (Inactive/archived accounts). After another separator: 'فلتر مخصص...' (Add custom filter, a domain builder).
- 'تجميع حسب' (Group By, layers icon): 'نوع الحساب' (Account type), then 'مجموعة مخصصة' (custom group-by, a field select).
- 'المفضلات' (Favorites, star icon): 'حفظ البحث الحالي' (Save current search, expandable).

features.name: Import accounts
features.details: 'استيراد' (Import) button in the Chart of Accounts control panel for bulk-loading accounts from a file. The import wizard was not opened.

features.name: Account selector autocomplete with code, name and description
features.nameAr: منتقي الحساب بالإكمال التلقائي (الرمز والاسم والوصف)
features.details:
The Account many2one on a journal item line opens a dropdown of about 8 results, each '<6-digit code> <name>' with an optional grey description line, then 'البحث عن المزيد...' (Search More...). A loading toast shows while it fetches. Examples:
- 100001 الأموال قيد التحويل
- 100101 حق استخدام الأصول (IFRS 16)
- 100102 الاستهلاك المتراكم استخدام حق الأصول (IFRS 16)
- 100103 ضريبة القيمة المضافة المدينة
- 100105 بناء: 'تشييد المباني والتكاليف المرتبطة بها'
- 100106 تأسيس: 'مشتريات التركيبات المتعلقة بالمباني، مثل الألواح الشمسية أو السخانات'
- 100107 الآلات والأدوات: 'الآلات والأدوات المرتبطة مباشرة بعملك'
- 100108 الأثاث والمعدات: 'النفقات الكبيرة المتعلقة بأماكن العمل'
This confirms that accounts carry a description field.

features.name: 6-digit numeric account code scheme
features.details:
All codes have 6 digits.
- 1xxxxx assets: 1001xx fixed assets and IFRS 16; 100103 VAT receivable; 1010xx outstanding receipts/payments and cash boxes; 1020xx receivables; 104020 prepaid; 1111xx cash; 1112xx banks; 116004 bank suspense; 131100 inventory.
- 2xxxxx liabilities: 200100 accruals; 2010xx payables, owner payable, deferred income 201018, VAT 201030.
- 3xxxxx equity: 310001 capital; 320001 owner current account; 3400xx owner/partner drawings.
- 4xxxxx profit and loss: 410001 revenue; 4000xx cost of revenue and expenses.
- 5xxxxx: 511001 cost of goods (default product expense).
- 9xxxxx: 999997/999998 cash discount gain/loss.
The prefixes are only loosely hierarchical, and report placement follows the account type (COA-03).

features.name: Owner and partner equity, current and drawings accounts
features.nameAr: حسابات رأس مال المالك والشريك والجاري والمسحوبات
features.details:
Accounts and Trial Balance figures (Sep 2026):

features.name: Default Posted filter on journal entries

features.name: Alternative views for journal entries

features.name: Create manual journal entry

features.name: Draft to Posted workflow with numbering at posting
features.nameAr: دورة المسودة إلى المرحّل مع الترقيم عند الترحيل

features.name: Chatter with messages, notes, activities, followers and field tracking
features.nameAr: سجل المحادثة مع الرسائل والملاحظات والأنشطة والمتابعين وتتبّع الحقول
features.details:
Buttons: إرسال رسالة (Send message), ملاحظة (Log note), النشاط (Schedule activity). Icons: search messages, attachments (1), followers (1; 0 on a new record). The timeline is grouped by date (اليوم, or ١٢ سبتمبر ٢٠٢٦) and shows the author 'Rya Cafe' with a time. Tracking on MISC/2026/09/0006:
